blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Four of the most wanted individuals in Caraga (Region 13) were arrested in separate operations on Wednesday, Nov. 18, police said. Brig. Gen. Rolindo M. Suguilon, director of the Police Regional Office-13 (PRO-13), said the suspects were apprehended through court-issued warrants served by the local police in Agusan del Sur, Surigao del Sur and Surigao del Norte. In Esperanza, Agusan del Sur, local police nabbed a 28-year-old suspect known only as alias “Tonton” in Barangay Guadalupe.
